latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Image to Video by AI" skill.
- Instantly converts uploaded still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p animated video clips via cloud AI.
- Simple setup: automatic token handling and backend session management.
- Convenient user workflow: upload images, describe the desired video, and download the final MP4.
- Handles credits, uploads, exports, and error messages—all in a chat-friendly flow.
- Designed for quick video creation for marketers and social media creators without manual editing.
